$comment: Upstream repositories this page indexes. build.py walks each for SKILL.md files, dedupes by skill name (shallowest path wins, so a repo that mirrors a skill into two directories contributes it once), and prerenders a card for each. Adding a source here is the only change needed to include it.

sources.note: Own library. Vendored imports keep their upstream licences; see its THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
Mirrors its skills into both cw/skills and skills; dedupe collapses them.
